original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). ITC experiments were conducted on an Affinity ITC instrument (TA Instruments, New Castle, DE) at 25 °C with a stirring rate of 75 rpm. RXRα, RXRβ, or RXRγ LBD protein (20 μM each, prepared as described previously13,18) in buffer (20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 5% glycerol) containing 5% DMSO was titrated with the test compounds 23, 27, and 29 (100 μM in the same buffer containing 5% DMSO) in 26 injections (1 μL × 1 μL and 25 μL × 3 μL) with an injection interval of 180 s. As control experiments, the test compounds were titrated into the buffer, and the buffer was titrated into the RXR LBD proteins under otherwise identical conditions. The heat rates of the compound-RXR LBD titrations were analyzed using NanoAnalyze software (TA Instruments, New Castle, DE) with an independent binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Profiling of 23, 27, and 29 as chemical tools. (a) 23 and 27 were selective over related nuclear receptors; 29 exhibited weak PPAR agonism. Heat map shows mean relative activation compared to the respective reference agonist, n = 3. (b) Predicted lipophilicity (AlogP) and solubility (AlogS) of 23, 27, and 29 (computed with the ALOGPS resource23). Reference RXR agonist bexarotene (1) for comparison.
